purpose: Review-gated personal salon proposal landing pages with variantA-level visual quality.
quality_signals: Two-font design system using sans and serif stacks.
Six or more typography size/weight steps.
Gradient first view with layered depth.
Layered box shadows on cards, image slots, and final CTA.
Smooth transitions on navigation, buttons, cards, menu rows, and reveal states.
Subtle keyframes for first-view reveal and floating review note.
IntersectionObserver reveal behavior without external scripts.
Mobile-first responsive grids with tablet and phone breakpoints.
guardrail_summary: Do not promise outcomes, performance, bookings, sales, ranking, or customer acquisition.
Do not make medical, body-shape, or efficacy assertions.
Do not criticize the recipient's current site, booking flow, copy, tools, or competitors.
Use customer voices only when real permissioned data exists; otherwise keep PLACEHOLDER labels.
Label all image slots as samples requiring replacement after photo permission.
Keep the proposal draft label visible: 提案サンプル(ドラフト・未送信).
sample_status: Five Kumamoto review demos are rendered in samples/kumamoto_review_20260613/.
